A faithful portfolio version

Built from the real PairNest product shape.

The full project is a Next.js and TypeScript application with a Postgres/Prisma data model, calendar connection support, custom events, partner settings, and multilingual UI. This page deliberately removes the database and integrations while retaining the real product story.

PairNest, in this demo

A calm place for a couple’s shared context.

PairNest is not another group chat or social feed. It is designed as a personal space for a pair to collect ideas, see the same calendar, work towards future goals, and save the moments that matter.
